title: Audit log exporter: wire private retention + export sinks (installer/helm/terraform)
author: Priya Desai
body: Context: Private deployments must be able to export and retain audit logs per customer compliance policies. This change wires the audit-log-exporter into the Private installer and Helm charts, adds Terraform modules for creating/exporting sinks (S3/GCS/BigQuery), and enforces retention settings via the operator. Motivation: customers requesting end-to-end automation for compliance (Linear ENG-1423) and a recurring support case where on-prem clusters were missing configured sinks (SUP-987). What this PR does: 1) Installer wiring: private-installer now templates audit-log-exporter configuration from installer values and supports per-tenant sink overrides; includes a migration path that runs a one-time job to populate existing clusters with sink metadata. 2) Helm: chart audit-log-exporter values extended with sinks.{s3,gcs,bigquery} and retentionDays fields; chart supports disabling export for air-gapped installs. 3) Terraform: new module private/terraform/modules/audit_log_sink that provisions export targets (S3/GCS/BigQuery) and outputs sink connection secrets for the installer; added examples for aws and gcp. 4) Operator & runtime: operator reconciler now validates retention (min/max) and applies enforcement annotations; added a graceful fallback when a sink is unreachable (writes to local buffered store and retries). 5) Upgrade path: includes post-install Job (migrate-audit-exports) with clear rollback steps and an upgrade-checker script that ensures required IAM roles and KMS keys exist before applying. 6) Tests: unit tests for helm templating, e2e test harness in perf-canary to verify end-to-end export to a test GCS bucket, and a terraform plan integration test. Checklist: - [x] Installer wiring and templating - [x] Helm values + schema updates - [x] Terraform module and examples - [x] Operator retention enforcement - [x] Migration/upgrade job + rollback notes - [x] Unit & integration tests - [x] Docs: added private deployment guide section and RBAC note Limitations and notes: - BigQuery export uses a best-effort schema mapping for event payloads; customers with strict schemas should provide a mapping file. - Air-gapped installs must provide a local object store endpoint; operator will buffer exports locally when remote sinks are unavailable. Rollout plan: staged canary via perf-canary -> selected Dedicated customers -> general availability. See related PRs: pr-18412, pr-19234, pr-19845 for prior audit-log-exporter wiring iterations.
commits: feat(installer): template audit-log-exporter sinks and retention values
feat(helm): add sinks.* values and schema validation to chart
feat(terraform): add private.audit_log_sink module with s3/gcs/bigquery examples
fix(operator): retention validation and buffered fallback on sink failure
test: add e2e terraform plan and helm template tests
docs: private deployment audit logging guide and RBAC notes
reviews: Marcos Ruiz: Left a couple of nits on variable naming and suggested extracting common sink code into utils; asked for an integration test to cover BigQuery path.
Priya Desai: Addressed Marcos comments, moved helper functions to operator/pkg/sinks and added terraform plan test for BigQuery example.
Elena Park: Approved after test addition; requested explicit RBAC lines in docs for KMS and storage roles.
Omar Haddad: Verified terraform examples in cloud CI and requested a follow-up to add Prometheus metrics for buffered export queue length.
release_notes: Private installer: automated wiring for audit-log-exporter sinks and retention policies
Terraform: new module to provision audit export sinks (S3/GCS/BigQuery)
Helm: values to configure export targets and retention; supports air-gapped installs
Operator: retention enforcement and buffered fallback when sinks are unreachable
testing_notes: Run perf-canary e2e suite to validate export to test GCS bucket (credentials in CI secret)
Terraform examples validated with terraform 1.5.0 and AWS provider v5 in CI
Upgrade: run ./scripts/upgrade-checker --ensure-iam before applying to production clusters
